summary: Phase 5 full test pass. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/phase5_test.py (24 tests) covering Trip PATCH (owner-only, currency immutability, date validation + stops_out_of_range 422, version bump, 401/404), KM auto-calc under ORS_MOCK=1 (Roma→Milano 574, Milano→Firenze plane 249.5, Roma→Napoli 225, London→Paris 460, Lisbon→Sintra 30, unknown city null, mode 'other' null, recalc on PATCH location/transport_mode, recalc on reorder, manual_override survives reorder + recompute), POST /trips/{id}/recompute-km (owner/editor 200, viewer 403, payload shape), GET /notifications/cancellation-alerts (auth, window (-inf, +7d], severity red<=3 incl. negative, yellow 4-7, sorting, field set, membership isolation), and OpenAPI. Full regression: 202/205 passed (2 obsolete Phase-1 tests in backend_test.py updated by me; 3 remaining failures are real defects). Frontend: verified NotificationsBell (badge=3, popover items, links to /trip/{id}, green 30d correctly excluded), Trip sub-header KM total ('1573+ km' with null leg, '1981 km' without), KmChip values + 'manual' lock chip, EditTripModal (currency locked/disabled, valid save updates header title without reload, 422 out-of-range banner + itemized stop list), owner-only Pencil (viewer sees 0), stop create → km chip appears via trip-sync refetch. Found 1 high-priority UI bug: RED DeadlineBadges render with computed opacity 0 (invisible).

minor.issue: `km_calc_error` is written to Mongo but is NOT a field on models.Stop, so it is never returned by the API. Spec requires km_calc_error=true for unresolvable locations; frontend therefore cannot distinguish 'not computed' from 'error'. Add km_calc_error: bool = False to StopBase/Stop.

Response is built from the pre-insert dict, so km_from_prev is always null even though recompute_stop_km() already stored the value (e.g. Roma→Milano returns null instead of 574). Re-read the doc after recompute before returning. Currently masked in UI only because trip-sync polling refetches.
total_km is still hardcoded to None ('# Phase 5') even though per-stop km now exists; UI shows 'KM total: —' next to a working '1981 km' chip in the same sub-header.

ui_bugs.issue: RED badges (deadline <=3d and expired) are INVISIBLE: computed opacity = 0. Root cause: the pulse spread `{...(severity==='red' ? {animate:{scale:[1,1.06,1]}, transition:{...}} : {})}` overrides the earlier `animate={{scale:1, opacity:1}}`, so the element stays at initial opacity 0. Fix by merging opacity:1 into the pulse animate object. Yellow (In 5d) and green (In 30d) badges render fine.
All hotel badges share the same static testid 'hotel-deadline-badge'; should be per-hotel (e.g. hotel-deadline-badge-{hotel_id}) for reliable assertions.
Hardcoded placeholders '0 km', '0 {currency}' and a 'phase 1' tag, even though the trip has 1981 km and €480 of costs.
'KM total: —' hardcoded dash (summary.total_km null) shown right beside the working km-total chip — duplicated/contradictory info in the sub-header.

issues: Date fields use the browser-native <input type=date> picker instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere in the design system

rca_of_the_issue: Red DeadlineBadge invisibility: framer-motion props are spread after `animate={{scale:1, opacity:1}}`, and the red-severity spread supplies its own `animate` object without opacity, replacing the original animate target; the element therefore remains at `initial.opacity = 0`. Verified via getComputedStyle -> opacity '0' for 'In 2d' and 'Expired 4d ago' badges while yellow/green report '1'.
